exposure: maternal anemia severity (non-anemic, mildly anemic, moderately anemic, severely anemic)
cohort: 200 pregnant women beyond 28 weeks of gestation, categorized by anemia severity based on WHO hemoglobin criteria.
finding: The severity of maternal anemia in pregnancy is directly associated with adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes, with moderate to severe anemia significantly increasing the risk of obstetric complications and poor neonatal health indicators.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher among severely anemic women.
